999008199.text:
は～、暇ねぇ……遊ぼうにも、
見渡す限り山しかないし

localizations.en: Ugh, I'm so bored... There's nothing to do out here but stare at mountains.

999008199.text:
いいじゃない。綺麗な湧き水に、美味しい空気。
休むには最適な場所よ

localizations.en: I think it's lovely. Fresh spring water, clean air... perfect place to rest.

999008199.text:
よく言えば田舎、悪く言っても田舎……
そういう所だよね

localizations.en: Charitably speaking, it's the countryside. Uncharitably speaking... also the countryside.

999008199.text:
いいじゃないか。田舎で結構。
レスナたちの故郷を悪く言うもんじゃないよ

localizations.en: And what's wrong with that? Don't go talking badly about Resna's hometown.

999008199.text: でも、退屈なのは確かかも

我々はともかく、多くの人間は
肉体と精神の疲労を癒す時間が必要

localizations.en: We may be fine, but most humans require time to recover from physical and mental exhaustion.

999008199.text:
キューンは、だいぶ元気になった。
ようやく不平不満を口にしてくれるように……

localizations.en: Quinn is looking much better. She is finally voicing her grievances again...

999008199.text: まさか、愚痴ってほめられるなんて

localizations.en: I didn't think I'd ever get complimented for complaining...

999008199.text:
まあ、確かにはたから見てると、
長男長女に脅されて従ってた末っ子ではある

localizations.en: Well, from where I'm standing, you looked like the youngest sibling getting bossed around by the older two.

999008199.text:
猫被ってるんだよ。
普段は結構甘えん坊だからね

localizations.en: She's just been playing it safe. She's actually quite the softie when she lets her guard down.

999008199.text: えー、そっかな？

はは、ゴゥやヤドヴィガには甘やかされてたからね。
でも、今回の戦いで一皮むけた気がするよ

localizations.en: Ha. You were spoiled rotten by Zero and Jadwiga, that's for sure. But I think this fight brought something new out of you.

999008199.text:
確かに。限界近く……もしかしたら限界以上に
力と勇気を引き出して頑張ってたかも

localizations.en: It did. You pushed yourself to your limit—maybe even past it. You really came through.

999008199.text: そっかな、えへへ……

といっても、もうヘルト兄貴やゼロ姉貴に逆らうのは
怖すぎるからやりたくないけど

localizations.en: Though honestly, I never want to go up against Held or Zero again. That was way too terrifying.

999008199.text:
まったくね。今回はたまたま助かったけど、
命がいくつあっても足りないよ

localizations.en: Agreed. We got lucky this time, but that's not the sort of situation you want to walk into twice.

999008199.text: そういうわりには、スカッとした顔してるけどね

localizations.en: Yet here you are looking perfectly pleased with yourself.

999008199.text:
そりゃまあ暴君に一発反撃できたんだから、
そこはすっきりしたけど

localizations.en: Well sure, landing a hit on a tyrant does feel pretty satisfying. I won't pretend otherwise.

999008199.text:
あはは……
今後の仕返しが怖いから、私はつくづく小物かも

localizations.en: Ahaha... I'm already dreading any payback, so I really am just a small fry at heart...

999008199.text:
そんな私が勇気を出せたのはね、
ヴァレリア姉ちゃんがいたからだよ

localizations.en: The only reason I was even able to be brave was because of you, Valeria.

999008199.text: え、私？

うん。ヴァレリア姉ちゃんが頑張ってる姿を
見てたから、自分も頑張ろうって思えたんだ

localizations.en: Yeah. Watching you keep going... it made me think I could keep going too.

999008199.text:
頑張りなら、それこそアルビーナとか
クレオなんかも頑張ってたと思うけど

localizations.en: I wasn't the only one fighting hard out there. Alvina and Creo gave everything they had too.

999008199.text:
ううん。記憶を失っても、お姉ちゃんはやっぱり
お姉ちゃんだった。かっこよかったよ

localizations.en: I know. But even without your memories... you were still you. Still my big sister. It was incredible.

999008199.text:
諾。背中を見て、ついていけば間違いない。
そう思える安心感があった

localizations.en: Affirmative. There was comfort in knowing that if we followed your lead, we would not go wrong.

999008199.text:
い、いやー、そう面と向かって言われると、
なんか、恥ずかしいわね

localizations.en: I— well... when you put it like that so directly, it's... kind of embarrassing.

999008199.text:
よかったじゃん。ちゃんとお姉ちゃん、
やれてるってよ

localizations.en: Take the win. You're doing just fine as a big sister.

999008199.text: いたたっ、強く叩きすぎだって！

localizations.en: Ow—! That was harder than you needed to pat!
